name: elephants_by_the_lake
label: Elephants by the Lake (Krishnagiri)
description: Zerodha/Rainmatter 70-acre dry-deciduous forest restoration near Veppanapalli, Krishnagiri, TN. Ponds at ~12.735N 78.184E (from the 2024 faunal survey).
ecoregion: South Deccan Plateau dry deciduous forests
landscape: 70-acre degraded parcel under active native-forest restoration; site NDVI is greening (0.49->0.61, 2019-2025, faster than the Melagiri forest reference), currently classes as Shrubland (regenerating). Reservoir/pond-fed; on the Hosur-Dharmapuri elephant landscape. Corridor bbox widens to reach occurrence density (37k -> 1.7M GBIF records).

wii_corridors.note: published PDF atlas covers Hosur/Dharmapuri; NO open shapefile — request from WII / digitize

analog_note: Same ecoregion, among the most-studied elephant landscapes in Asia. Use for paper/occurrence-thin questions, tagged aoi_status=analog_ecoregion.

catalogs.note: reachable populated CKAN — mechanism demo only (out-of-region)
India national catalog — production target; data API key-gated

data_gaps_to_collect: elephant movement / corridor GIS (request from WII or camera-trap it)
mammal camera-trap grid (sloth bear etc. — GBIF sparse)
repeat annual biodiversity survey on fixed transects (own time-series)
